title: conjure — consequence

translations.translation: 念咒召唤；用魔法驱赶；提出，想象；恳求

phrases.translation: 想起，使在脑海中显现；用魔法召唤

sentences.sentence: The magician conjured a rabbit out of his hat.
sentences.translation: 魔术师从帽子里变出一只兔子来。

sentences.sentence: We’d like two rooms with connecting doors (= doors that join the rooms ) .
sentences.translation: 我们想要两个有门相通的房间。

phrases.translation: 法兰接头；法兰联接；凸缘联接

sentences.sentence: Police have so far failed to establish a connection between the two murders.
sentences.translation: 到目前为止警方尚未确定两宗凶杀案之间有关联。

sentences.sentence: The evidence was there in the file but no one made the connection .
sentences.translation: 证据就在档案里，但没有人把它们联系起来。

sentences.sentence: Students often see little connection between school and the rest of their lives.
sentences.translation: 学生往往看不到上学和今后生活的联系。

sentences.sentence: He demonstrated the close connection between social conditions and health.
sentences.translation: 他证明了社会条件和健康之间的密切联系。

sentences.sentence: a wine connoisseur
sentences.translation: 品酒专家

translations.translation: 内涵；含蓄；暗示，隐含意义；储蓄的东西（词、语等）

sentences.sentence: a negative connotation
sentences.translation: 负面的含义

sentences.sentence: The term "organization" often connotes a sense of neatness.
sentences.translation: “组织”这个词常常给人一种整洁的感觉。

sentences.sentence: The Normans conquered England in 1066.
sentences.translation: 诺曼人于 1066 年征服英格兰。

sentences.sentence: Egypt was conquered by the Persian king Kambyses.
sentences.translation: 埃及被波斯国王冈比西斯征服。

phrases.translation: 征服者威廉（英国国王威廉一世，等于William I）

sentences.sentence: The people of an oppressed country obey their conquerors because they want to go on living.
sentences.translation: 一个被压迫国家的人民顺从他们的征服者，是因为他们想活下去。

phrases.translation: [史]诺曼底人对英格兰的军事征服

sentences.sentence: the Norman Conquest (= the conquest of England by the Normans )
sentences.translation: 诺曼征服

sentences.sentence: Well, at least I can face them all with a clear conscience (= the knowledge that you have done nothing wrong ) .
sentences.translation: 好吧，至少我可以问心无愧地面对他们所有人。

sentences.sentence: I can’t tell you what to do – it’s a matter of conscience (= something that you must make a moral judgment about ) .
sentences.translation: 我不能告诉你怎么办——这是良心问题。

sentences.sentence: a crisis of conscience among medical staff (= a situation in which it is very difficult to decide what is the right thing to do )
sentences.translation: 医务人员中的良心危机

translations.translation: 认真的；尽责的；本着良心的；小心谨慎的

sentences.sentence: A conscientious teacher may feel inclined to take work home.
sentences.translation: 一个认真负责的教师可能会想着把工作带回家去做。

sentences.sentence: a conscientious and hard-working student
sentences.translation: 勤勉刻苦的学生

translations.translation: 意识到的；故意的；神志清醒的

sentences.sentence: The driver was still conscious when the ambulance arrived.
sentences.translation: 救护车赶到时，司机仍然神志清醒。

phrases.translation: 群体意识，团体意识；集体意识

sentences.sentence: The painful memories eventually faded from her consciousness.
sentences.translation: 那些痛苦的回忆最终从她的意识中淡去了。

sentences.sentence: Hypnosis is an altered state of consciousness .
sentences.translation: 催眠状态是一种被改变的意识状态。

sentences.sentence: research into human consciousness
sentences.translation: 对人类意识的研究

sentences.sentence: How can private companies compete fairly when their military rivals enjoy access to cheap land, credit and conscript labour—and have guns?
sentences.translation: 军方享有廉价的土地、信贷和士兵做劳工，而且手中有枪，私营公司怎么和他们公平竞争？

translations.translation: 奉献；使神圣；供神用；献身于

sentences.sentence: The bones will be reburied in consecrated ground .
sentences.translation: 尸骨将被重新安葬在圣地里。

phrases.translation: 连续营业日；连续作业日

sentences.sentence: It had rained for four consecutive days.
sentences.translation: 雨接连下了四天。

sentences.sentence: Can they win the title for the third consecutive season?
sentences.translation: 他们能连续第三个赛季赢得冠军称号吗？

sentences.sentence: The EU Council of Finance Ministers failed to reach a consensus on the pace of integration.
sentences.translation: 欧盟财政部长会议未能就一体化的进度达成共识。

sentences.sentence: the current consensus of opinion
sentences.translation: 目前观点上的一致

sentences.sentence: The general consensus was that technology was a good thing.
sentences.translation: 大家都认为科技是好东西。

sentences.sentence: the consensus politics of the fifties
sentences.translation: 50年代的共识政治

translations.translation: 同意；（意见等的）一致；赞成

phrases.translation: 知情同意，知会同意；知后同意

sentences.sentence: He finally consented to go.
sentences.translation: 他最终同意去。

sentences.sentence: I don’t suppose it is of any consequence now.
sentences.translation: 现在我觉得这事一点都无所谓了。

text:
英语词汇 · 专八 · 第 140 单元

conjure
音标：英 /'kʌndʒə/  美 /'kʌndʒɚ/
v. 念咒召唤；用魔法驱赶；提出，想象；恳求
短语：conjure up — 想起，使在脑海中显现；用魔法召唤
例句：The magician conjured a rabbit out of his hat.
魔术师从帽子里变出一只兔子来。

connect
音标：英 /kə'nekt/  美 /kə'nɛkt/
v. 连接；联合；关连
短语：connect with — 连接；与…联系
短语：connect up — 连接，接上
短语：network connect — 网络连接
例句：We’d like two rooms with connecting doors (= doors that join the rooms ) .
我们想要两个有门相通的房间。

connection
音标：英 /kəˈnekʃn/  美 /kə'nɛkʃən/
n. 连接；关系；人脉；连接件
短语：in connection with — 与……有关；与……相连
短语：connection with — 与…的关系
短语：close connection — 紧密联系
短语：internet connection — 网络连接，因特网联通
短语：in this connection — 在这一点上
短语：network connection — 网络连接；网络接线
短语：direct connection — 直接连接
短语：parallel connection — 并联
短语：series connection — 串联
短语：data connection — 数据连接
短语：electrical connection — 电气连接；导电连接
短语：ground connection — 接地
短语：flange connection — 法兰接头；法兰联接；凸缘联接
短语：cable connection — 电缆连接；缆索接头
短语：personal connection — 人际关系；人事关系
短语：seamless connection — 无缝连接；无缝链接
短语：electric connection — 电连接；电接头
短语：flexible connection — 柔性连接；活动连接
短语：pipe connection — 管接头；管道连接
短语：wire connection — 线缆接头；电线接头
例句：Police have so far failed to establish a connection between the two murders.
到目前为止警方尚未确定两宗凶杀案之间有关联。
例句：The evidence was there in the file but no one made the connection .
证据就在档案里，但没有人把它们联系起来。
例句：Students often see little connection between school and the rest of their lives.
学生往往看不到上学和今后生活的联系。
例句：He demonstrated the close connection between social conditions and health.
他证明了社会条件和健康之间的密切联系。

connoisseur
音标：英 /,kɒnə'sɜː/  美 /,kɑnə'sɝ/
n. 鉴赏家；内行
例句：a wine connoisseur
品酒专家

connotation
音标：英 /kɒnə'teɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,kɑnə'teʃən/
n. 内涵；含蓄；暗示，隐含意义；储蓄的东西（词、语等）
例句：a negative connotation
负面的含义

connote
音标：英 /kə'nəʊt/  美 /kə'not/
v. 意味着；含言外之意
例句：The term "organization" often connotes a sense of neatness.
“组织”这个词常常给人一种整洁的感觉。

conquer
音标：英 /'kɒŋkə/  美 /'kɑŋkɚ/
v. 战胜，征服；攻克，攻取
短语：divide and conquer — 分而治之；各个击破
例句：The Normans conquered England in 1066.
诺曼人于 1066 年征服英格兰。
例句：Egypt was conquered by the Persian king Kambyses.
埃及被波斯国王冈比西斯征服。

conqueror
音标：英 /'kɒŋk(ə)rə(r)/  美 /'kɑŋkərɚ/
n. 征服者；胜利者
短语：william the conqueror — 征服者威廉（英国国王威廉一世，等于William I）
例句：The people of an oppressed country obey their conquerors because they want to go on living.
一个被压迫国家的人民顺从他们的征服者，是因为他们想活下去。

conquest
音标：英 /'kɒŋkwest/  美 /'kɑŋkwɛst/
n. 征服，战胜；战利品
短语：norman conquest — [史]诺曼底人对英格兰的军事征服
例句：the Norman Conquest (= the conquest of England by the Normans )
诺曼征服

conscience
音标：英 /'kɒnʃ(ə)ns/  美 /ˈkɑːnʃəns/
n. 道德心，良心
短语：a clear conscience — 问心无愧
短语：guilty conscience — 内疚
短语：have no conscience — 没有良心；不辨是非
短语：social conscience — 社会道德
短语：in all conscience — 凭良心；当然；公平地说
短语：have a clear conscience — 问心无愧
短语：in good conscience — 凭良心；公平地
例句：Well, at least I can face them all with a clear conscience (= the knowledge that you have done nothing wrong ) .
好吧，至少我可以问心无愧地面对他们所有人。
例句：I can’t tell you what to do – it’s a matter of conscience (= something that you must make a moral judgment about ) .
我不能告诉你怎么办——这是良心问题。
例句：a crisis of conscience among medical staff (= a situation in which it is very difficult to decide what is the right thing to do )
医务人员中的良心危机

conscientious
音标：英 /,kɒnʃɪ'enʃəs/  美 /'kɑnʃɪ'ɛnʃəs/
adj. 认真的；尽责的；本着良心的；小心谨慎的
例句：A conscientious teacher may feel inclined to take work home.
一个认真负责的教师可能会想着把工作带回家去做。
例句：a conscientious and hard-working student
勤勉刻苦的学生

conscientiously
音标：英 /kɔnʃi'enʃəsli/  美 /kɑnʃɪ'ɛnʃəsli/
adv. 良心上

conscious
音标：英 /'kɒnʃəs/  美 /'kɑnʃəs/
adj. 意识到的；故意的；神志清醒的
短语：conscious of — 意识到
短语：become conscious of — 观察到
短语：safety conscious — adj. 有安全意识的
例句：The driver was still conscious when the ambulance arrived.
救护车赶到时，司机仍然神志清醒。

consciousness
音标：英 /'kɒnʃəsnɪs/  美 /'kɑnʃəsnəs/
n. 意识；知觉；觉悟；感觉
短语：social consciousness — 社会意识
短语：legal consciousness — 法律意识
短语：national consciousness — 民族意识；国族意识
短语：stream of consciousness — 意识流（一种文学流派）
短语：safety consciousness — 安全意识
短语：loss of consciousness — 意识丧失
短语：class consciousness — 阶级意识
短语：public consciousness — 公共意识；公开意识
短语：collective consciousness — 集体意识
短语：regain consciousness — 苏醒；恢复知觉
短语：self consciousness — 自我意识；自觉意识
短语：group consciousness — 群体意识，团体意识；集体意识
短语：lose consciousness — 失去知觉
短语：disturbance of consciousness — 意识障碍
短语：tactical consciousness — 战术意识
例句：The painful memories eventually faded from her consciousness.
那些痛苦的回忆最终从她的意识中淡去了。
例句：Hypnosis is an altered state of consciousness .
催眠状态是一种被改变的意识状态。
例句：research into human consciousness
对人类意识的研究

conscript
音标：英 /kən'skrɪpt/  美 /kən'skrɪpt/
n. 应征士兵
v. 征召
adj. 被征召的
例句：How can private companies compete fairly when their military rivals enjoy access to cheap land, credit and conscript labour—and have guns?
军方享有廉价的土地、信贷和士兵做劳工，而且手中有枪，私营公司怎么和他们公平竞争？

consecrate
音标：英 /'kɒnsɪkreɪt/  美 /'kɔnsi,kreit/
v. 奉献；使神圣；供神用；献身于
adj. 神圣的；被献给神的
例句：The bones will be reburied in consecrated ground .
尸骨将被重新安葬在圣地里。

consecutive
音标：英 /kən'sekjʊtɪv/  美 /kən'sɛkjətɪv/
adj. 连贯的；连续不断的
短语：consecutive days — 连续营业日；连续作业日
短语：consecutive interpreting — 交替传译
短语：consecutive reaction — 连锁反应
例句：It had rained for four consecutive days.
雨接连下了四天。
例句：Can they win the title for the third consecutive season?
他们能连续第三个赛季赢得冠军称号吗？

consensus
音标：英 /kən'sensəs/  美 /kən'sɛnsəs/
n. 一致；舆论；合意
短语：reach a consensus — 达成共识
例句：The EU Council of Finance Ministers failed to reach a consensus on the pace of integration.
欧盟财政部长会议未能就一体化的进度达成共识。
例句：the current consensus of opinion
目前观点上的一致
例句：The general consensus was that technology was a good thing.
大家都认为科技是好东西。
例句：the consensus politics of the fifties
50年代的共识政治

consent
音标：英 /kən'sent/  美 /kən'sɛnt/
v. 同意；赞成；答应
n. 同意；（意见等的）一致；赞成
短语：informed consent — 知情同意，知会同意；知后同意
短语：written consent — 书面同意；同意书
短语：mutual consent — 双方同意
短语：by common consent — adv. 大家都同意（公认）
例句：He finally consented to go.
他最终同意去。

consequence
音标：英 /'kɒnsɪkw(ə)ns/  美 /'kɑnsəkwɛns/
n. 结果；重要性；推论
短语：as a consequence — 因此，结果
短语：in consequence — 因此；结果
短语：as a consequence of — 因此；由于…的结果
短语：in consequence of — 由于…的缘故
短语：of consequence — 重要，有意义
短语：of no consequence — 无足轻重
短语：evil consequence — 恶果
短语：immediate consequence — 直接后果
短语：economic consequence — 经济后果；经济结果
例句：I don’t suppose it is of any consequence now.
现在我觉得这事一点都无所谓了。
